name: daemonmap
$comment: NOTE: The recommended Windows build path is MSYS2/MinGW-w64, NOT vcpkg+MSVC.
Run build.ps1 (PowerShell) or build-msys2.sh (MSYS2 terminal) instead.
This file is provided for future MSVC support. If you do attempt an MSVC build,
you will also need to fix threading (the code uses pthreads on POSIX and Win32
threads via GDEF_OS_WINDOWS — MSVC needs the latter path wired in CMake).
Full dep list for vcpkg if pursuing the MSVC route:
glib  (pulls in pcre2, zlib, libffi, gettext)
